Sam_Sales: Quick heads-up — HelixHealth renewal next week. CFO flagged that sign-off is contingent on a p99 latency SLA and us committing to a custom routing capability. Can product weigh in? cc @Aya_PM @Jordan_CS
Aya_PM: Thanks Sam. Need to surface options quickly. Routing feature is medium effort (est ~3 sprints) and high impact for them but unclear how many other customers benefit. Options: (A) commit to product timeline, (B) recommend Dedicated + config + SLA, (C) contractual fallback + discount. Recommend a quick RICE sketch.
Jordan_CS: They're pushing hard. Renewal is ~$1.2M ARR. Legal will insist on precise SLA metrics and penalties. They said Dedicated is acceptable if onboarding can be fast.
Leo_Eng: From infra: p99 ~200ms for their model at their qps is unlikely on shared hosted without throttling. Dedicated pool + KV cache tuning + batching can hit it, but needs capacity bump and infra changes. Rough effort: ~6–8 eng-weeks + SRE runbook.
Aya_PM: Quick RICE sketch:
```
R = 0.1  # reach (single customer)
I = 8    # impact (big logo, revenue)
C = 0.6  # confidence
E = 6    # effort (eng-weeks)
RICE = (I * R * C) / E = (8 * 0.1 * 0.6) / 6 = 0.08
```
Interpretation: low product priority as a pure roadmap bet unless commercial incentives change.
Priya_Director: This is the classic roadmap vs commercial ask. Proposal: offer a 6-month dedicated pilot with an SLA at a premium rate, include a clause that productization requires cost-share. Also require canary + fallback (smaller model, throttles) for graceful degradation.
Sam_Sales: Can we offer a 90-day pilot starting as soon as next Monday? They want business-critical uptime. They're willing to pay for Dedicated and onboarding fees.
Leo_Eng: 90-day pilot operationally feasible but needs 2 weeks prep for infra + onboarding + run chaos tests. We'll need SRE support during pilot and a 20% capacity premium to guarantee headroom.
Jordan_CS: I'll draft the amendment language with pilot terms, acceptance criteria, rollback triggers, and a clear SLA definition (metrics, measurement window, exclusions).
Aya_PM: Action items: Jordan to draft amendment by EOD tomorrow; Leo to confirm prep timeline and exact resource reqs; Priya to approve commercial package. I'll put a decision checkpoint on Wed PM sync. If they ask to productize after pilot, we'll re-evaluate with RICE but require cost-share / commercial commitment. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary for dedicated onboarding script scheduled Thu 03/27 02:00 UTC
Priya_Director: +1. Emphasize we can't derail the roadmap — this path is commercial-first. If the pattern repeats and shows broader reach, we'll prioritize.
Sam_Sales: Got it. I'll present the pilot offer and get verbal ok. Will update this thread when I have commitment.
